Activity registry with done/total counts, a unit, a kind, set_cancellable and numeric ids; InlineCancelRegistry rows carry label, message and a 0..1 fraction under string ids. See the activity row of docs/rightkit-port/cut-list.md.

Synchronous JSON-RPC server loop (handle_line, batches, three protocol revisions) that crates/mcp tests and tests/e2e.rs drive; the rightkit-mcp ServerHost swap needs the e2e run on a host. See the mcp row of docs/rightkit-port/cut-list.md.
Progress and cancel wire of the same server loop; goes with server.rs when ServerHost is adopted.
Mirror fallback with a bearer token scoped to one host and progress across a model's files over the owner download_resumable; the owner has neither the host scope nor the aggregate progress.
Ember's Url/Limits/get/post_json surface over rightkit-http with Ember policy (no redirects, no retries, cancel flag and stall limit); shrinks when map tiles and photo-ai move to the owner client.
Length-prefixed frames of the remote SAM protocol; a click-only request sends a zero-length RGB frame, which rightkit-sidecar length_prefixed refuses.
Copies of the shell's rightkit_logs_write/collect/clear commands because Ember's own RotatingTextWriter queue cannot be handed to the shell LogsRuntime.
Bundled ffmpeg search before the owner verification; ResolveOptions::bundle_dir is on RightKit main and not in the published 0.2.10. Only if the video crate is kept.
ensure_runtime: find, verify and bind the ONNX Runtime library once per process; waits for the installed-runtime bind in rightkit-onnx. Optional feature onnx-accel.
OpenRouter chat-completions transport with a capability preflight; rightkit-llm 0.3.1 covers it. Own-model crate, scheduled with the cloud comparison.
Image scale-down request for the same transport.
Hand-written Tauri CSP, capability and pin assertions; the shared CSP and capability drift check is requested in the doctor.
egui locale table (1,432 lines) with macro; the Rust localisation owner is not published. Moot if ui-egui is dropped (Orthic-Labs/ember#269).
Build-time codegen for the egui locale table and its 24 JSON locale files.
Hand-coded egui token palette with no link to @rightkit/theme; consumer of resolved tokens once the owner publishes them.
Padded base64 encoder and lenient decoder for the persisted mask payload; the owner decoder is strict, so the swap waits for a stored-form check.
